source: Derived 20 October 2026 from firm-skills/concession-agreement/references/fill-map.md (the 10 choices, the 11 optional blocks, the 4 directives and the 8 conditional footnotes, by slot id), schedules.md (Schedule P), known-issues.md (Change in Law) and the plan's clause list (Article 12, Article 17, the arbitration forum). The root decisions come first so that the footnotes and choices they settle are settled with them.
name: Concession agreement drafting decisions
applyWhere: the clause named above, the definitions in Section 1.1 and Schedule B, the schedules and any other clause that depends on it
closing: That completes the drafting decisions. What remains are the deal's facts — the Agency and the Concessionaire, the project and its jurisdiction, the dates, the periods and percentages in Schedule B, the revenue bands in Schedule R and the termination percentages in Schedule T. Give them to me in the chat, or point me at the project documents that hold them, and I will fill each [●].
